sources.title: pawanpaudel93/clef-flash-int8-ov-decision · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Clef-flash's full fine-tune weights swapped into Intel's int8 Qwen3.5-9B IR, plus Clef's joint schema head as an OpenVINO model under decision/. It is a 1-stage tree for a single box (about 10.7 GB), the exporter's default.

sources.title: Clef — Cloudflare's 27B Decision Model: Benchmarks, Price
sources.snippet: Clef Cloudflare's open 27B multimodal decision model on Qwen3.8-27B that scores typed questions instead of writing text, behind a Jev-compatible API on Workers AI, released October 2026.

sources.title: Cloudflare releases Clef and Clef-flash decision models on Workers AI
sources.snippet: Cloudflare launches Clef and Clef-flash, its first in-house open-weight decision models on Workers AI, with low latency and input-only pricing.

sources.title: pawanpaudel93 (Pawan Paudel) · GitHub
sources.snippet: Instant, resettable Windows, Ubuntu and Arch Linux ARM desktop VMs for AI agents on Apple Silicon Macs, over MCP. Runs x64 Windows apps and x86 Linux programs too.

sources.title: clef (Cloudflare) · Cloudflare AI docs · Cloudflare Workers AI docs
sources.snippet: Clef is a 27B multimodal decision model that turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It reads the state as text, JSON, images, or video, and returns a probability for every allowed option of every question.
